title: Scoped negative result: R439 retirement windows across all 713 B cuts
body:
PR1256 explicitly leaves later B cuts of PR1128's six width-seven helpers open. This scoped negative result checks **all713 cuts /4278 helper-cut pairs** of the fixed PR589 B chronology. The exact necessary-condition windows are helper465 after10–48 B records,468 after31–88, and470 after0–517. Helpers466,469 and476 never pass both the joint restoration/erasure-rank and first-restoration target-access tests.

The concrete new exclusion is helper466: its joint rank becomes8 after zero-based B[78], before its blocking target208 is read at B[88]. Waiting for that target read cannot rescue it in this fixed chronology. Passing a window is **not** a suffix construction, physical admission or new kappa. Lower-frame preparation, reordered target reads, changed prefixes and extra transport remain outside the model.

Only `research/r439-later-retirement-cuts/` is added. The primary checker updates inverses incrementally; a separate checker rebuilds the entire inverse from scratch at every one of713 boundaries, with separate set-state and integer-geometry replay. They agree on every cut, donor set and lost-target set. Both import no predecessor executable code.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/r439-later-retirement-cuts
```

Expected: `PASS_LATER_BIT_CUTS pairs=4278`, `PASS_INDEPENDENT_LATER_CUTS full_inverse_rebuilds=713 helper_cut_pairs=4278`, ten passing test groups, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The registered Python3.12.13 replay passes; the census suite also passes under isolated optimized Python3.14.7. Controls cover six altered census claims, boundary indexing, donor/target support, missing coverage, source corruption, offline relocation and exact regeneration, plus the retained stationary fixture controls. Selected-record integrity and its five regression tests pass. Native/hosted supplier admission, the selected cold replay and remote CI are not claimed.

Exact base: `dadfea6e8a78ff6ba901705f87532a71c6f5bbb8`; OS seed17, user-assigned bit track. Ali Romman's PR1128 (`df29b159239b79d7e451d6ddda826a73e0e50a67`) supplies the boundary lemma and six candidates. Ross Richardson's concurrent PR1256 (`d6d5a994fcdcd8d04ec439ff988daa8f37b17ece`) supplies the first-restoration target-access implication and finite two-frame helper470 continuation. Its arrival subsumed our initial stationary experiment; that material is explicitly corroborative, and the single evidence-driven pivot is to its unsearched later-cut question. Exact source/document pins, bounded domain and next steps are recorded in the package. No selected or `upstream/` files change.

Credit also Sagar Thakrar's PR1023 hosting incentive, Ali Romman's earlier PR1043 helper470 deletion, DreamingOfClouds/eumemic's PR589/555 word, and the retained compiler/hosting lineage. Prepared for **Philipp (@mightyOil)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex / GPT-6 Astra** assistance; Apache-2.0. Separate implementations are not independent human review or formal verification of the multiplication theorem.
